answers.note: Three sides. WIDENS implies KEEPS of each admitted formation's own line and implies GENERATES of the line of moments. Between KEEPS and GENERATES the statement is ACROSS: they are said of two carriers (each formation by name; the admitted range over the moments), as the docstring itself says ('two carriers, so they are not the map's two grains of one carrier'). The denied 全生成 on the occurrences follows from 全守 there by the definitions. Docstring against statement: 'from nothing lost alone' names a weaker premise than the statement hands in (the full `keeps`), and 'no occurrence is 全生成' is wider than the statement, which denies it only of occurrences admitted from T on.
